scripts.build:app: pnpm --filter @workspace/blockfit run build:web && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.rmSync('dist', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.cpSync('artifacts/blockfit-app/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
